description: Core user journey checkpoints for the journey board (#2370). A proof lists, in execution order, the checkpoints that its test marks with journey_checkpoint.checkpoint(). A checkpoint with no proof is not covered and names the issue that tracks the gap.

checkpoints.title: The user uploads a statement through the product
The live provider parses the statement and its rows equal the independent fixture
Stage 1 auto-accepts a clean source (AI classification enabled) and sends a broken source to review
The user reviews and approves the source through browser actions
The user records the opening balance through the browser
Each accepted source transaction has exactly one posted ledger effect
A transfer between two accounts clears through the Processing account
Report totals equal the independent Decimal oracle
Twelve consecutive months tie out on a deployed revision
The saved package lists, reopens and exports, and stays unchanged after a later posting
A report line traces to its source decision
The test ran against the pinned deployed revision
The proportion of low-confidence data is measured
